newsitem.title: USA: Newport News Shipbuilding in Defense Dept contract.
newsitem.headline: Newport News Shipbuilding in Defense Dept contract.

text.p: Newport News Shipbuilding Co was awarded a nearly $176 million increase to a previously awarded contract for work on the USS Nimitz, the U.S. Defense Department said.
The contract is part of the advance planning and material procurement for the Refueling and Complex Overhaul (RCOH) of the ship, the Pentagon said in a statement.
Work is expected to be completed by March 1998 and will be done in Newport News, Va. Contract funds will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year.
